cards.answer: Azir is a mage and marksman who fights through Sand Soldiers whose attacks deal magic damage in a line. His damage scales with AP, and he can dash to soldiers and knock enemies back with his ultimate.
cards.counterplay: Move away from soldier attack lines and watch Azir's approach before committing.

cards.answer: Azir can build a temporary Sun Disc turret on destroyed turret ruins outside the enemy base. It deals magic damage, loses health over time, and loses defenses when Azir is dead or too far away.
cards.counterplay: Avoid fighting under the Sun Disc; consider pressuring it after Azir leaves.

cards.answer: Q sends all active Sand Soldiers toward a target location, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies along their paths and in front of them on arrival.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep the soldiers' paths and move away from their landing area.

citations.quote: Azir orders all Sand Soldiers to dash toward the target location, dealing magic damage to all enemies they pass through as well as those in front of them upon arrival, and slowing them by 25% for 1 second.

facts.claim: Q sends all active Sand Soldiers toward a target location, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies along their paths and in front of them on arrival.

cards.priority_reason: Repositioning soldiers extends his threat and sets up follow-up attacks.

cards.answer: W summons an untargetable Sand Soldier that grants nearby sight. When Azir attacks a target in a soldier's range, the soldier attacks for him, dealing magic damage in a line. Soldiers expire faster near enemy turrets and disappear if Azir moves too far away.
cards.counterplay: Move out of soldier range and avoid lining up behind their targets.

citations.quote: Azir summons a Sand Soldier at the target location that is untargetable, lasts 10 seconds, and grants sight of its surroundings.

facts.claim: W summons an untargetable Sand Soldier that grants nearby sight.

citations.quote: When Azir declares a basic attack against an enemy in a soldier's attack range, the Sand Soldier attacks in his stead, thrusting their spear in the target's direction to deal magic damage to enemies struck in a line.

facts.claim: When Azir attacks a target in a soldier's range, the soldier attacks for him, dealing magic damage in a line.

citations.quote: The Sand Soldier expires twice as fast while within range of an enemy turret, and does so instantly if Azir is too far away.

facts.claim: Soldiers expire faster near enemy turrets and disappear if Azir moves too far away.

cards.priority_reason: Soldier range and attack lines define his sustained damage zones.

cards.answer: E shields Azir and dashes him toward a Sand Soldier, dealing magic damage along his path. Hitting an enemy champion stops his dash and grants a W charge. The dash follows the soldier if Q moves it.
cards.counterplay: Watch soldier positions and leave room for Azir to redirect his approach.

citations.quote: Azir shields himself and dashes to the target Sand Soldier, dealing magic damage to enemies he passes through.

facts.claim: E shields Azir and dashes him toward a Sand Soldier, dealing magic damage along his path.

citations.quote: If Azir dashes into an enemy champion, he stops and gains a charge of Arise!.

facts.claim: Hitting an enemy champion stops his dash and grants a W charge.

citations.quote: Azir will track the Sand Soldier if they change locations, such as by Conquering Sands.

facts.claim: The dash follows the soldier if Q moves it.

cards.priority_reason: His shielded dash enables escapes and redirected approaches.

cards.answer: R sends a wall of soldiers forward, dealing magic damage and knocking enemies back; it can catch enemies behind Azir. After charging, the soldiers remain as terrain that blocks enemies while Azir and his allies can pass through.
cards.counterplay: Keep space around Azir and avoid positions where his knockback could isolate you.
